t: This is the site of the General Post Office on St Martin's Le Grand. Built in 1829, it was England's first purpose-built post office, and for eighty years, until 1910, it served as the main post office for London and the headquarters of the General Post Office of the United Kingdom. It was designed by Sir Robert Smirke, a leader of Greek Revival architecture who also designed the main block and façade of the British Museum. He was highly respected for his accuracy and professionalism.
